title: 通联数据 MCP 对接配置
description: 连接您的通联数据账号，用于查询 A股/港股、基金、指数、债券、宏观与公告数据。Token 仅存储在本机 ~/.workbuddy 下，不会上传到云端。
description_en: Connect your DataYes account to query A-share/HK equities, funds, indices, bonds, macro data and announcements. The token is stored locally under ~/.workbuddy only and is never uploaded to the cloud.
docLabel: 如何获取通联数据 MCP Token？
docLabel_en: How to get a DataYes MCP token?

fields.label: 访问令牌 (Token)
fields.placeholder: 在 Datayes! MCP → 个人中心 → 个人信息 → Token 中复制
fields.placeholder_en: Copy it from Datayes! MCP → Personal Center → Profile → Token
fields.description: 用于访问通联数据 MCP 服务的访问令牌，同时决定您的数据权限与积分账户。
fields.description_en: Access token for the DataYes MCP service. It also determines your data entitlements and credit account.
